description: The Baumkataster of the City of Zürich records all city street trees managed or maintained by Grün Stadt Zürich, supplemented by the fruit tree inventory, trees in selected public green spaces and private trees. It is used to manage and care for public trees and to plan their replacement, and gives planners and project designers the existing tree positions and species. Since 2001 street tree positions have been surveyed by total station, with trunk-centre accuracy from under 1 cm to 30 cm, while private trees and trees in green spaces are mostly located to 0.5 to 2 m; the main changes come from the yearly replacement of street trees, and condition surveys and care measures are recorded for green spaces. The dataset is published under the Creative Commons CC Zero licence as CSV, DXF, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, Shapefile and WFS, WMS and WMTS services, is updated weekly (last on 30 August 2026), and comes with attribute descriptions on geocat.ch and online notebooks. Access is free. Caveats: coverage of trees in green spaces is being completed step by step, and the accuracy differs between street and other trees. Coverage is the City of Zürich and neighbouring municipalities. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure analysis, such as urban heat mitigation and storm damage to trees along roads and power lines; related records are the USFS urban forest inventory and the global urban tree LAI dataset.
